What is Beautiful.ai?

Presentation tool built on 'smart slide' templates that automatically maintain professional design rules - as you add or remove content, the layout rebalances itself, so slides cannot easily be made ugly.

Best for

Enforcing consistent, professional design across a team's decks.

Main features

  • Smart Slide templates that auto-adjust layout, spacing and alignment as content changes
  • DesignerBot generating a full deck from a prompt
  • brand kit enforcing fonts, colours and logos across a team
  • slide library for approved reusable slides
  • collaboration and commenting
  • presentation analytics
  • PowerPoint and PDF export
  • version history
  • theme controls.

Practical use cases

  • Producing a consistent sales deck across a distributed team
  • building a board presentation that looks designed
  • enforcing brand compliance on every deck the company produces
  • quickly restructuring a deck without breaking layouts.

Who is it for?

  • Corporate teams, consultants, sales organisations and anyone who needs consistently professional decks without a designer.

Pricing, free access & limits

Per-seat subscription; no meaningful free tier

Plans described in the source

Pro around $12/mo billed annually (roughly $144/yr; higher billed monthly) for individuals. Team around $40-50/user/mo billed annually with brand kit, slide library, shared workspaces and admin controls. Enterprise custom, annual, with SSO and dedicated support. Beautiful.ai removed its free plan some years ago; a 14-day trial is the evaluation route.

Free plan

No free plan.

Free trial

Yes - 14-day free trial, no card required.

Usage limits to consider

No hard usage limits on decks or slides; limits are on seats and feature tiers. Brand kit, slide library and analytics are Team tier and above.

Strengths & tradeoffs

These points summarize the supplied research, rather than hands-on test results.

Strengths noted in the source

  • The smart-template constraint is the point - it genuinely prevents bad slides, which is more valuable in a large organisation than more freedom would be
  • brand kit enforcement is strong and practical
  • the slide library for approved content solves a real sales-enablement problem
  • output consistently looks professional.

Limitations to consider

  • The same constraint frustrates anyone who wants a specific custom layout - you work within the templates or not at all
  • no free tier makes evaluation commitment-heavy
  • AI generation (DesignerBot) is weaker than Gamma's
  • PowerPoint export is functional but not perfect
  • RTL and Arabic support are poor
  • expensive at the Team tier.

Platforms, languages & integrations

Platforms

  • Web, iOS, Android
  • PowerPoint and PDF export

Languages

  • English interface; content in any language, though RTL support is limited

API access

No public API

Integrations and exports

  • PowerPoint and PDF export, Google Slides import, Slack, Dropbox, Google Drive, Monday.com, Salesforce (Team tier)

Evaluation notes

Try to build one of your existing decks during the 14-day trial - if the templates cannot express your required layouts, this tool will frustrate you permanently. Best-fit is an organisation that wants to constrain, not empower, slide creation.
